Affects videos.list_videos, videos.get_video, taxonomies.list_terms, taxonomies.count_terms. 'all' / 'null' paths work because they avoid the ANY comparison. Summary: Revised the Real-Debrid torrent ranking algorithm in js/streaming.js. Fixes: (1) word-boundary regex so 'ts' no longer matches DTS audio, 'cam' no longer matches camera/campaign - previously most quality releases with DTS audio were penalized -10000 as Telesyncs. (2) Replaced N-concurrent checkRDCached Promise.all storm with a single batched checkRDCachedBatch() that uses RD's multi-hash instantAvailability endpoint (40 hashes per call, 250ms gap between chunks) - protects against rate-limiting. (3) Richer scoring: source tier (remux>bluray>web-dl>webrip>hdtv>dvdrip), codec bonus (AV1/HEVC>AVC), HDR/DV tier (DV>HDR10+>HDR), Atmos/TrueHD/DTS-HD bonus, log-curve seeder health with dead-torrent penalty, size sanity (rejects fake 4K under 6GB and oversized over 80GB remuxes per quality tier), encoder reputation (YIFY penalty, FraMeSToR/QxR/etc bonus). (4) Quality scoring now rewards exact match of the user's preferred quality ceiling more strongly (+100 vs scaled tq*15).

Summary: Multi-video refine. --video is now action=append so the launcher accepts N clips; first is the manifest primary, rest go into manifest.metadata.extra_videos. _run_frame_extraction loops over extra_videos AFTER the primary: each extra is ffprobed for duration, extracted at compute_extraction_fps into its own TemporaryDirectory, blur-pruned to FRAME_KEEP_TARGET (so a long clip cannot monopolise the budget), then moved into frames/ with an extra<N>_ prefix. Per-video pruning is the point: with combined-set pruning a 348s cloudy + 130s sunny would land 73% cloudy. Base-job merge still runs last with a base_ prefix. Net: sunny (base) ~280 + cloudy1 ~280 + cloudy2 ~280 = ~840 frames into one COLMAP run.

Summary: Added free-look pivot mode to viewer.js. Holding BOTH mouse buttons simultaneously snapshots camera.quaternion as fpsBaseQuat, disables OrbitControls, and rotates the camera in place via the same scalar yaw/pitch math FPS mode uses — but WITHOUT engaging pointer lock, so the cursor stays visible for precise framing. Releasing either button restores OrbitControls. Free-look takes priority when both go down during pointer-lock FPS: exitPointerLock is called before flipping the freeLook flag so the pointerlockchange handler does not re-enable OrbitControls between modes. Window blur clears both button state and freeLook to avoid stuck-in-free-look after alt-tab. Status line at scene-load now advertises the binding.

Summary: Per-job sticky Flip Up + game-style FPS pitch fix. (a) Viewer now persists the Flip Up state to <job>/usd/viewer_state.json via a new ViewportBridge.viewerFlipChanged(bool) slot. JS flipCameraUp toggles isFlipped and notifies Python; Python loads the JSON on reload_scene and appends flip=1 to the viewer URL when set; JS auto-calls flipCameraUp({silent: true}) at load. Fixes gravity_align PCA-skewness occasionally guessing up-down backward on backyard scenes without making the user click Flip Up every reload. (b) Rewrote FPS pointer-lock math: previous axis-angle premultiply with reject-on-overshoot was rejecting EVERY pitch delta when the camera started polar (single-axis movement symptom the user reported). New approach snapshots camera.quaternion at FPS entry as fpsBaseQuat, accumulates scalar fpsYaw + fpsPitch, builds orientation as qPitch * qYaw * fpsBaseQuat each frame. Pitch trivially clamped to +/-88.8deg; base preserves any Flip Up roll so mouselook stays correct after righting. Also noted user workflow: P key in the viewer toggles dot visualization to surface sparse regions for next capture session (saved to memory).

Summary: FPS-mode follow-ups. (a) Replaced Euler YXZ yaw/pitch tracking with axis-angle quaternion premultiply against camera.quaternion. Reason: setFromEuler discarded any roll introduced by Flip Up, so after the user righted the scene their mouselook felt inverted; premultiply preserves it. Yaw axis is the (mutable) worldUp shared with flipCameraUp, so Flip Up now also flips A/D and E/Q via the cross-product / scaled-worldUp paths. Pitch clamp via |forward.dot(worldUp)| < cos(~1deg) instead of explicit Euler clamp. (b) Cached SceneBounds in ViewportTab keyed on (preview_ply path, mtime). bounds_from_preview_ply was reading 200K points and running np.percentile on every Apply+Preview Pattern click — measured hundreds of ms felt by user as ~1.5s mode-switch pause. _get_bounds_cached returns the cached instance; set_job invalidates.

Summary: Added FPS pointer-lock camera mode to viewer.js. Right-click+hold locks the cursor and enters game-style mouselook (yaw around world +Y, pitch around camera-right, roll forced to 0 via Euler YXZ, pitch clamped to +/-89deg). WASD walks along camera horizontal-forward (pitch does not slow walking); QE raises/lowers along world up. On lock, OrbitControls is disabled; on release, target snaps to camera_pos + forward*3 so capture poses and post-FPS orbit pivot stay coherent. Also enforced camera.up=(0,1,0) at scene load so gravity-aligned splats no longer start upside down (removes need to hit Flip Up on every load). Status line updated to advertise the new control. captureCamera() unchanged — still derives lookAt from controls.target, which the FPS handler keeps on the camera ray.

Summary: Smart init-pair picker + DB archival to close out the init-pair lottery. User pasted Gemini diagnosis aligning with mine: failure is mapper init-pair, not matcher. Gemini's init_max_reg_trials suggestion isn't a real COLMAP flag in current builds (real lever is init_num_trials, which I already bumped); other directional advice was correct. Implementation: (1) new smart_init_pair_candidates(database_path, top_n=4) reads two_view_geometries.rows from the COLMAP database, decodes pair_id via the kMaxNumImages=2147483647 encoding, ranks pairs by num_matches * temporal_distance, requires temporal gap >= 30 frames (~5 sec at 6 fps) so spatial baseline is real, dedupes by image_id so each candidate samples a different region of the capture. (2) retry_mapper rewritten: each attempt now passes explicit --Mapper.init_image_id1/2 from the smart picker plus a progressively-relaxed threshold ladder (8/4/2/1.5 init_min_tri_angle, 50/30/20/15 init_min_num_inliers, abs_pose floors). Added ensure_vocab_tree() helper that lazily downloads vocab_tree_flickr100K_words256K.bin from demuc.de/colmap on first use, caches at /tmp/. ns-process-data invocation appends --vocab-tree-path when matching=vocab_tree. Falls back gracefully (stops at sequential) if download fails. vocab_tree is O(n log n) vs exhaustive's O(n^2), runs in ~10 min instead of 30-45, and catches loop closures sequential misses. (3) MIN_REGISTERED dynamic: new MIN_REGISTERED_RATIO=0.5 constant, per-job target = max(MIN_REGISTERED_IMAGES=10, frame_count * 0.5). For typical 280-frame job, fails at <140 instead of <10. Error message rewritten to point at scene texture + capture motion + lighting + glass/water/mirror traps. (4) presets.py standard: downscale_factor 2 -> 1 (full-res training), est_minutes 35 -> 60. Tradeoff: 4x pixels per training iteration but sharper final splat. Standard remains DEFAULT_PRESET_KEY. Draft and high left unchanged. Worker syntax compiles, full suite 77/77 still passes. Summary: Second consecutive HF Job COLMAP failure on user's video input. Status: still RUNNING in exhaustive matching fallback (HF Job 6a2c2ff4871c005b5352b55b on backyard_134s_sunny.mp4), 25 min in. Sequential matching finished retry_mapper 2 with 2/270 images registered. Root cause is input video quality, not pipeline: keypoint match rate is 150-180/5000-8000 = 2-3% between consecutive frames. SfM needs ~20%+ for stable registration. Backyards are a known-hard SfM target due to (a) large textureless areas (grass, sidewalks, sky), (b) repeating textures (fence slats, lawn) that produce false matches, (c) sunlight shadow drift between frames. Yesterday's cloudy backyard succeeding 280/280 was lucky given the same underlying constraints. Recommended user re-record with: textured scene focus (around plants/structures, not open lawn), slower camera movement (70%+ frame overlap), consistent lighting (cloudy actually beats sunny for SfM). Awaiting user decision: kill now (lose ~0.33 USD), let exhaustive finish (probably succeeds but 30-45 min more + 0.40-0.60 USD more), or accept partial reconstruction.

Summary: Two viewport fixes. (1) viewer.js:197 'undefined position' crash on Apply+Preview Pattern. Root cause: requestAnimationFrame's now and performance.now() use slightly different time bases in QtWebEngine, so on the very first step (now - startedAt) can be slightly negative, Math.floor gives -1, Math.min(frames.length-1, -1) is -1, frames[-1] is undefined, frame.position throws. Fix: clamp index with Math.max(0, ...) and add defensive guard that re-schedules instead of crashing if frame is malformed. (2) Camera angle presets to unstick from confusing poses. New JS hooks: window.snapToView('top'|'bottom'|'front'|'back'|'left'|'right'|'iso') snaps the orbit camera to a named world-space direction at the current orbit distance, forces world +Y up, dodges the gimbal pole when snapping straight vertical. window.flipCameraUp() rolls 180 deg around the forward axis (negates camera.up + re-lookAt) for one-click 'right myself'. New compact button grid in viewport panel: Top/Front/Side/Iso/Flip Up via QGridLayout (2x2 + full-width flip row). Strings in EN+QC. Suite: 77/77 pass, ViewportTab imports clean.

Summary: Three viewer.js fixes for navigation + pointer behavior. (1) Pointer-leave teleport fix: OrbitControls calls setPointerCapture but QtWebEngine does not reliably forward pointer events once the cursor leaves the WebEngine widget bounds, so the drag never receives pointerup and the next pointermove on re-entry registers a huge delta. Tracking active pointers on the renderer canvas and dispatching a synthetic pointerup on pointerleave cleanly ends the drag. (2) Real WASD fly: the status text already advertised 'WASD to fly' but the vendored OrbitControls only does arrow-key pan, so the user could only arc around the orbit target and never translate toward an arbitrary point (the 'can't go toward the house' issue). Added a heldKeys set + requestAnimationFrame loop that translates BOTH camera.position and controls.target by the same delta â€” the orbit pivot moves with the camera so WASD reads as first-person walking. W/S = forward/back along the look vector, A/D = strafe via right = forward x up, E/Q = world-up raise/lower. Shift triples speed. blur listener clears the held set so alt-tabbing doesn't leave keys stuck. Speed scales with orbit distance so the same key feel works far and close. (3) Updated status text to reflect the actual control set. Full test suite (excluding test_viewer_server which we already skipped): 68/68 pass.

Summary: Fixed real regression in dashboard->viewport job sync. Root cause: DashboardWidget._load_existing_job (gui_app.py:1280) is the handler for both 'Open Latest Job' and 'Open Job Manifest' buttons; it updated self.manifest and called _render_manifest but never emitted signals.manifest_changed. The ViewportTab listens for that signal at gui_app.py:1598 and calls set_job from it. No emit means no set_job means viewport keeps the initial _job_dir from app startup (typically the most-recent half-completed job that has no cloud.ply). reload_scene takes the splat-doesn't-exist branch, web_view.load(url) gets a bare URL with no scene= query, and viewer.js shows 'No scene loaded'. The signal IS emitted from the job-runner code path (gui_app.py:1372-1374) which is why the viewport works immediately after running a job but not after just opening one. User confirmed with screenshots: dashboard correctly on local-run-20260610-165858, Open3D fallback viewer renders the splat, but the QWebEngine viewport tab is stuck on 'No scene loaded' despite reload. Two-line fix: emit self.signals.manifest_changed.emit(manifest) at the end of _load_existing_job with comment explaining the dependency. Full test suite: 67/67 pass. Not an alignment bug, not an env/PySide bug â€” pre-existing wiring regression that masqueraded as the user's 'always broken' state.

Applies rotation to (a) cloud.ply positions and per-splat quaternions via composed Hamilton product, (b) cloud_preview.ply positions, (c) summary.json (gravity_aligned flag + alignment matrix block). Summary: Fix tray Settings semi-crash (tray icon vanishes, overlay persists). Root cause: tray MenuFlyoutItem Click handlers were async void; an exception inside ShowSettingsAsync (likely from null XamlRoot or wrong dispatcher thread) bubbled to App.UnhandledException, where the previous handler called ShutdownAsync() which disposed the tray. The overlay Window survived because it's separate. Fixes: (1) App.OnUnhandledException now sets e.Handled=true and only logs, instead of nuking the tray; (2) tray About/Help/Settings clicks marshal to MainAppWindow.DispatcherQueue via TryEnqueue wrapper SafeOnUiThread() which try/catches; (3) added EnsureMainWindowVisible() which re-Activates MainWindow before reading XamlRoot, since the window may be minimized to tray; (4) MainWindow.ShowSettingsAsync also Activates first, null-checks XamlRoot, and try/catches. App.slnx also updated to a single x64 solution platform to match the csproj. Build clean; republished Release self-contained.

Build clean (0 warn/0 err); dotnet publish -r win-x64 -c Release self-contained succeeds with VaultGuardian.UI.pri in publish folder alongside framework PRIs.

Summary: Pass 3 on WorkImpactPage agent section: discovered root cause is that update-work-impact-state.ps1 emits flattened arrays [name,count,name,count,...] instead of tuple arrays [[name,count],...] because PowerShells ForEach-Object pipeline unwraps single-element arrays returned by its script block. Fix at source: prefix each @(extglob.Key,extglob.Value) with the unary comma operator (,@(...)) so the pipeline preserves the inner array. Fix on frontend: extended toTuples helper to detect and recover the legacy flat format by walking pairs when no proper tuples are present (preserves existing prod data renderability without requiring a state regeneration). Verified against the live work-impact-data.json: actors=14, models=30, tools=15, mcpServers=2 — all recovered. tsc --noEmit passes. NOTE the apparent ProjectCard accordion breakage on prod was a side-effect of the agent section throwing during render, which unmounted the rest of the page; no separate fix needed there.

Summary: Reviewed proposed CI/assistant runner loop for non-production projects including vault-guardian. Confirmed GitHub Actions billing distinction from official GitHub docs: GitHub-hosted workflows consume Actions usage/minutes in private repos; self-hosted runner usage is documented as free in billing docs but GitHub also announced self-hosted private workflow platform charges from 2026, so safest low-cost design is to use GitHub webhooks as event source and run build/test entirely on tailnet infrastructure outside Actions. Summary: Round 3 feedback fixes â€” eight items. (1) CRITICAL bug fix: prompts/textareas were uneditable because FlowCanvas initialized rfNodes from storeNodes once and never re-synced. Added a useEffect in FlowCanvas that propagates store data changes (params, label) to rfNodes while leaving position/measured state untouched (preserves the visibility:hidden fix from earlier sessions). Identity-checks on params and label avoid spurious re-renders. (2) Toast system: new src/ui/components/Toast.tsx with module-level event hub (pushToast/dismissToast from anywhere) and ToastHost mounted at App root; renders top-right stack with auto-dismiss (6s default, 4s for success); three tones (error/success/info) with matching tokens. App.tsx now pushes 'success' on clean run, 'error' on per-node or top-level failure + auto-opens the inspector. (3) Execution errors moved to TOP of NodeParamPanel â€” banner with the failure detail + a Reset button; the old bottom error block was removed. Per-node text/json outputs still render below (image results render inline ON the comfyui_workflow node). (4) Removed the auto-created Display node from loadFromComfyWorkflow; the master flow is now just the single comfyui_workflow node, with results rendering inline (gallery + thumbnails). Eliminates the disconnected 'Result' node that felt orphaned. (5) Inline image result on ComfyUIWorkflowNode: when the workflow succeeds and the result has imageUrl/imageUrls, the gallery renders inside the node card itself; click any thumb opens full-size in a new tab. (6) New InlineSeedInput in canvas/nodes/inline.tsx â€” number input with a dice button (Lucide Dice5) that fills a 31-bit random int. ComfyUIWorkflowNode routes any input key named 'seed' through this control. (7) Size presets dropdown â€” when a workflow exposes both 'width' and 'height' in input_paths, a single 'size' InlineSelect drives both (512Â², 768Â², 1024Â², portrait/landscape variants, Custom reveals manual w/h number inputs). Exported SIZE_PRESETS array from inline.tsx. (8) NodeId pill â€” small mono badge at the bottom of every node card showing 'node#<short-id>'; tooltip on hover reveals the full id. shortenNodeId helper formats numeric/short/UUID ids consistently. (9) Persisted last-used inputs: ComfyUIWorkflowNode reads localStorage['vw:lastInputs:<workflow_id>'] on mount if all inputs are empty, prefills non-image fields (upload tokens excluded â€” they expire); debounced 400ms save on every input change. Each user gets their own browser-local memory of last prompt/seed/size per workflow. Deployed dist (assets/index-BxACQy3N.js).

(3) Updated 5 node renderers to render editable forms inside the card body: InputNode (textarea for value), LLMNode (model + prompt inline; system/temp/max_tokens behind Advanced), ModelCallNode (provider select + model/url + prompt inline; system/temp behind Advanced when provider==ollama; url replaces prompt when provider==http), TransformNode (template textarea), ComfyUIWorkflowNode (workflow_id chip + per-key input controls partitioned PRIMARY=positive_prompt/negative_prompt/prompt/source_image/target_image/reference_image/seed inline, everything else under Advanced; lazy-loads workflow schema via getPipelinesWorkflow when cache misses; inline image picker with upload+thumbnail+change-button matching the side panel's ComfyUIWorkflowInputsEditor pattern). Summary: Identified and fixed the real cause of the startup crash. After scanning a directory, the frontend called schedule-idle-previews with all items. For large folders or cloud directories (like iCloud Photos with 2,100+ items), this ran over 6,000 synchronous I/O operations (fs.existsSync) in a single loop on the main process thread, blocking the Electron main thread and triggering a native access violation crash/watchdog lock. Optimized the handler in previews.js to skip automatic background previews for cloud-backed directories (iCloud, OneDrive, Dropbox, etc.) and limited active batch size to 80 items in other folders. Rebuilt installer successfully.

Summary: Landed A2: full real-time progress + cancel for comfyui_workflow nodes. Backend (vaultwares-pipelines): added websockets dependency (16.0) to .venv + requirements.txt. _execute_comfyui_graph now takes optional progress_cb + cancel_event args. Spawns _comfyui_ws_listener as an asyncio.Task that subscribes to ws://127.0.0.1:8188/ws?clientId=<id>, filters events by prompt_id, calls progress_cb with executing/progress/executed/execution_error/execution_success/execution_cached events. If cancel_event is set during execution, POSTs to ComfyUI's /interrupt and raises RuntimeError('canceled'). _execute_workflow_run plumbs both through. Job worker creates: (a) a progress_cb closure that maintains a progress_state dict and writes it to job.progress with throttling (~5 Hz), (b) a watch_cancel asyncio.Task that polls the job record once per second and sets cancel_event when status==canceled. JobSummary/JobDetail gained a progress field. New GET /jobs/recent endpoint (registered before /jobs/{job_id} to avoid the same path-conflict the validation endpoint hit) returns the caller's most recently-updated job, filterable by kind and CSV status; admins see all jobs, non-admins only their own (matched via requested_by.username or special 'vault-flows' tag). Frontend (vault-flows): listed JobSummary + JobProgress types in client.ts; getRecentJob(opts) handles the 'null' body case; cancelJob(id) calls POST /jobs/{id}/cancel. New ExecutionProgressOverlay.tsx renders a fixed bottom-right card while executionStatus==='running' â€” polls /jobs/recent at 1 Hz, shows a pulsing accent dot, progress bar (when total>0), current message, node + step counter, elapsed time, and a Cancel button that calls cancelJob. App.tsx mounts the overlay. Verified end-to-end: started a 30-step run, observed live step progress (poll showed step 4/12, then step 2/30 etc, with current node id 3), POST /jobs/{id}/cancel mid-execution â†’ worker tripped /interrupt â†’ /flows/run returned with error='ComfyUI workflow was canceled', final job status=canceled. Deployed dist (assets/index-DCi4ZtfE.js) atomically.

Summary: Landed C + D from the next-step plan. (C) Workflow validation badges: pipelines now has GET /flows/validation that ports the local validator into the API â€” caches /object_info for 5 min (COMFYUI_OBJECT_INFO_CACHE_TTL), runs per-workflow against the cached schema, returns {workflow_id, verdict, summary, node_count, error_count}. Verdicts: pass / broken_wiring / blocked_subgraph / blocked_unknown_pack / blocked_missing_model / empty. SPA: listWorkflowValidations() typed helper; WorkflowLibrary fetches catalog + validations in parallel on mount, renders an 8px colored dot on each card (success=green, info=blue, warning=yellow, error=red), shows the verdict label in the card footer for non-passing entries, dims severity-2 (truly blocked) cards to 55% opacity. Added 'Show N broken workflows' toggle that defaults OFF so the picker only surfaces ready-to-use workflows. Endpoint route was originally /workflows/validation but conflicted with the dynamic /workflows/{id} route; moved to /flows/validation. Verdict classifier was looking for 'value not in list' (space-separated) but my error messages use 'value_not_in_list' (underscored); fixed the substring match. (D) Multi-image output: ExecutionResultOut in pipelines + ExecutionResult in vault-flows both gained an imageUrls: List[str] field alongside the existing imageUrl. _execute_comfyui_graph populates imageUrls when ComfyUI's history returned multiple outputs (previously dropped after the first). _forward_upstream_payload propagates imageUrls through display nodes. DisplayNode in vault-flows now renders a 2-column 80px grid when imageUrls.length > 1 (clickable thumbnails open full size in new tab, +N indicator for more than 6 images), single-image view unchanged. End-to-end verified: validation endpoint returns 14 workflows with correct verdict tally (3 pass / 3 broken_wiring / 4 blocked_subgraph / 3 blocked_unknown_pack / 1 blocked_missing_model); z-image-turbo run returns kind=image with imageUrls.count=1. Deployed dist (assets/index-CkaEeRg_.js) atomically to greencloud-vps; live on flows.vaultwares.ca and noddit.org.

This makes page refresh in the same tab keep the user logged in, while tab close still clears the token. Pipelines (.env): JWT_TTL_SECONDS=3600 â€” verified via login -> JWT payload exp-iat=3600s. NSSM service restarted. Built + deployed dist (assets/index-GzA-V8ki.js) atomically to greencloud-vps; live on flows.vaultwares.ca + noddit.org. Summary: Three workflow-toolchain improvements addressing 'workflow runs in ComfyUI but fails validation' false positives. (1) Converter (convert_proven_workflows.py): skips nodes with mode==2 (muted) and mode==4 (bypassed); for bypassed nodes, rewires consumer links from bypassed_node.output[N] to whatever feeds bypassed_node.input[N], following chains of bypasses. This is exactly what ComfyUI's editor's 'Bypass' mode does at runtime. Eliminates dangling links + 'missing model' false positives where the referenced model was in a bypassed node. (2) Fixer (fix_workflows.py): smarter _core_key() that strips quant markers (FP16/FP8/Q2_K/etc), distillation markers (DMD/DMD2/distilled), AIO/base tags, and minor-version suffixes (V1.0/V1.1/v1-1) â€” so different-quant or patch-version files of the same base model are treated as drop-in substitutes. Closest_match() now uses the core-key tier as high-confidence matching (returns first match, prefers top-level files over nested copies). Also added Pass 3: normalize_load_image_widgets() replaces baked-in LoadImage filenames with a placeholder ('000.jpeg' from D:\\comfyui\\resources\\comfyui\\inputs) so ComfyUI's validator passes; the worker overrides at runtime. (3) Diagnostic (dump_workflows_diagnostic.py): validate_locally() now exempts LoadImage's image input from validation for any node referenced by step.image_inputs[] â€” runtime-overridden inputs are never structurally broken from the worker's POV. Re-seeded: 13/13 workflows now match the fixed JSONs (muted nodes dropped, bypasses rewired). New verdict tally: PASS=3 (biglove-photo, ipadapter-faceswap, z-image-turbo-text2img), BLOCKED_SUBGRAPH=4 (custom-realistic, flux-conditioner-sampler-upscaler, qwen-image-text2img, gonzalomo-dmd-v30), BLOCKED_UNKNOWN_PACK=3 (copilot/flux2-klein-faceswap/wan22 â€” AI-invented), BROKEN_WIRING=2 (basic-lora-text2img orphan upscale chain, qwen-edit-multi-angle unwired CLIP), BLOCKED_MISSING_MODEL=1 (openpose-i2i), VALIDATION_OTHER=1 (qwen-image-edit-4step references muted ReferenceLatent). All remaining issues are real workflow content problems requiring editor surgery.

Click -> loadFromComfyWorkflow + closes sidebar. (4) src/ui/ComfyUIWorkflowInputsEditor.tsx: structured editor that pulls input_paths/image_inputs (cache-first, falls back to per-node hint fields, falls back to GET /workflows/{id}) and renders one labeled field per declared input â€” file picker w/ upload+preview for image_inputs, number input for seed/steps/width/height/cfg/denoise/strength keys, textarea for positive_prompt/negative_prompt/prompt/system/template, plain text otherwise. Writes back into params.inputs[key]. Also exposes workflow_id (read-only) + mode (local/nim) settings. (5) src/ui/NodeParamPanel.tsx routes node.type=='comfyui_workflow' to the structured editor; filters underscore-prefixed hint keys from the generic param loop. (6) src/App.tsx swaps PresetLibrary for WorkflowLibrary in the sidebar; renames the header toggle and empty-state CTA accordingly. Backend: added GET /workflows/{id} to api_server.py (the SPA editor falls back to this when the workflow isn't in cache). Deployed dist (assets/index-DbffKEaM.js) atomically to /var/www/vault-flows/dist on greencloud-vps; both flows.vaultwares.ca and noddit.org now serve the new bundle. Verified: catalog GET returns 14 workflows with input_paths/image_inputs, singular GET works (200 / 404), bundle hash matches on both hostnames.
